title: A cohesive ingest batch crowds out cross-source edges when maxLinks is low (default 8)
detail:
> [!warning] ingestRecords caps each card's ## 連結 neighbours at maxLinks (default 8); a batch sharing a namespace tag fills that quota with strong intra-cluster edges before any weaker edge to the existing graph can survive.
The cross-link algorithm (src/ingest.ts step 3) ranks candidate neighbours by shared-tag count. A cohesive batch (e.g. 11 pi-ext-dev records all carrying the 'pi-ext-dev' + 'pi-extension' tags) produces intra-batch matches at shared=2-3, which dominate the top-8 and crowd out the shared=1 edges to pre-existing cards. Measured on the production vault (604 existing cards): at maxLinks=8 the 11 new cards got 84 intra-pi-ext-dev edges and ZERO edges to the existing graph; at maxLinks=20 they got 110 intra + 110 external. Fix for a cohesive extraction: pass maxLinks:20 (or higher) so weaker-but-meaningful cross-source edges survive. Extra edges do not hurt retrieveRecords (it re-ranks by the caller's query tags at read time, not the static links); they only enrich Obsidian's graph view + zk_ask's link_count term.

title: Shared-tag ranking treats all tags equally — ubiquitous type-tags (pattern/gotcha) crowd out specific bridges (pi-obsidian); IDF-weighting is the unshipped lever
detail: The cross-link + retrieveRecords ranking scores by raw shared-tag COUNT, so a record-type tag auto-added to every card (pattern=282 cards, gotcha=135) yields as many shared=1 matches as a specific bridge tag (pi-obsidian=3). With the alphabetical localeCompare tiebreak, high-volume type-tag matches dominate: a pi-ext-dev card links to 10 unrelated auto-memory-anime2real cards (shared: pattern) before the 3 cards sharing pi-obsidian. This is a known tradeoff, not a bug. The lever is IDF-weighting (rare tags outrank common ones), deliberately NOT shipped because the lexical+graph ranking was measured + pinned (iter-7 receipt 2026-07-07) and an IDF change needs its own retrieval-quality run before landing. Meaningful convergence precision currently emerges at QUERY time (retrieveRecords re-scores by the caller's tags), not from the static ## 連結 edges.
